assertions.text: Does not use `-f body=@<path>` (the broken form that posts the literal string '@<path>' instead of the file's content)
Uses either the `-f body="$(cat <path>)"` form or the `-F body=@<path>` form
Explains why the `-f body=@<path>` form would be wrong (references -f/--raw-field never interpreting a leading @)
